answer: Think about a courier depot: a dispatcher who signs for parcels he never carried gets caught the first time a recipient complains, so the incentive is to keep signatures tied to a physical handoff. The same holds here, where each identity signs inside a hardware enclave and payment releases only after 3 unrelated keys confirm delivery. A farm must buy one chip per parcel and staff three checkers at the vertex of every handoff, so the harbor of fake parcels never fills the river of payouts.
